page: CORS Middleware for cross-origin requests in Web APIs. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {cors} from 'hono/cors'. HTTP headers: Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods, Access-Control-Allow-Headers, Access-Control-Max-Age, Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, Access-Control-Expose-Headers. Options: origin (default '*'), allowMethods (default ['GET','HEAD','PUT','POST','DELETE','PATCH','QUERY']), allowHeaders (default []), maxAge (number), credentials (boolean), exposeHeaders (default []). Origin types: string, string[] array, (origin, c) => string function. allowMethods types: string[] array, (origin, c) => string[] function. Vite integration: set server.cors: false in vite.config.ts to avoid conflicts. Use @cloudflare/vite-plugin. Environment variables: c.env.CORS_ORIGIN for dynamic config. Pattern: call cors() inside async middleware for env-based config. Middleware order: apply CORS before routes. Questions: How to enable CORS? Can I restrict origins? How to allow multiple origins? sections.manifest: Import statements for CORS middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for the main framework class. import {cors} from 'hono/cors' for the middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is cors located?

CORS middleware usage patterns. Pattern 1: Basic CORS. app.use('/api/*', cors()). Pattern 2: Detailed configuration. app.use('/api2/*', cors({origin: 'http://example.com', allowHeaders: ['X-Custom-Header', 'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests'], allowMethods: ['POST', 'GET', 'OPTIONS'], exposeHeaders: ['Content-Length', 'X-Kuma-Revision'], maxAge: 600, credentials: true})). Pattern 3: Multiple origins as array. cors({origin: ['https://example.com', 'https://example.org']}). Pattern 4: Function-based origin. cors({origin: (origin, c) => origin.endsWith('.example.com') ? origin : 'http://example.com'}). Pattern 5: Dynamic methods by origin. cors({origin: (origin) => origin === 'https://example.com' ? origin : '*', allowMethods: (origin, c) => origin === 'https://example.com' ? ['GET','HEAD','POST','PATCH','DELETE'] : ['GET','HEAD']}). Order: apply CORS before routes. Questions: How to configure CORS? How to set origin? What methods are allowed? Can I use functions? Can methods depend on origin? What headers can I expose?

CORS middleware options specification. Optional: origin (string | string[] | (origin: string, c: Context) => string, default '*', sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin header). Optional: allowMethods (string[] | (origin: string, c: Context) => string[], default ['GET','HEAD','PUT','POST','DELETE','PATCH','QUERY'], sets Access-Control-Allow-Methods header, can be dynamic per origin). Optional: allowHeaders (string[], default [], sets Access-Control-Allow-Headers header, example ['X-Custom-Header', 'Upgrade-Insecure-Requests']). Optional: maxAge (number, sets Access-Control-Max-Age header for preflight caching). Optional: credentials (boolean, sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header, enables cookie/auth). Optional: exposeHeaders (string[], default [], sets Access-Control-Expose-Headers header, example ['Content-Length', 'X-Kuma-Revision']). Questions: Which options are required? What are the defaults? How to set multiple values? Can options be functions? What headers does each option set?

Environment-dependent CORS configuration pattern. Use c.env environment variables for dynamic CORS setup. Pattern: app.use('*', async (c, next) => { const corsMiddlewareHandler = cors({origin: c.env.CORS_ORIGIN}); return corsMiddlewareHandler(c, next); }). Benefits: eliminates hardcoding, supports dev/prod environments, config from external sources. Access environment variables with c.env in async middleware. Call cors() inside handler with dynamic values. Questions: How to use environment variables for CORS? What's the async pattern? Can I configure per-request? How to support multiple environments? What if env var is undefined?

Hono and Vite integration for CORS. Set server.cors: false in vite.config.ts to disable Vite's built-in CORS. Prevents conflicts between Vite and Hono CORS middleware. Use @cloudflare/vite-plugin for Cloudflare integration. Configuration example: export default defineConfig({server: {cors: false}, plugins: [cloudflare()]}). Questions: Why disable Vite's CORS?
